idea: A 9-minute video about building OpenClaw specialist agents that turn vague ideas into finished workflows
constraints: no credentials or tokens in the package
sourceNotes: A specialist agent is just a scoped role plus a playbook the agent has to read every run. The failure mode is starting from a blank prompt each time, which produces a different shape of output every run. The fix is a checked-in playbook file that the agent parses at runtime, so the standard and the output cannot drift apart. Once the playbook exists, the agent's job shrinks to judgment: the structure is guaranteed by the file, so the model spends its attention on the parts that actually need taste.
